name: Claude Usage

prefix.label: Präfix der Sensoren
prefix.description: Entity-ID ohne „sensor.“ und ohne Endung, z. B. claude_usage_my_account aus sensor.claude_usage_my_account_session_limit_usage

modelLimit.label: Modell-Limit
modelLimit.description: Modellteil des Wochenlimits pro Modell, z. B. sonnet oder opus. Leer lassen, um die Zeile auszublenden.

template: <Stack gap="sm" p="sm"><Group justify="space-between" wrap="nowrap"><Group gap="xs" wrap="nowrap"><Image src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/homarr-labs/dashboard-icons/svg/claude-ai.svg" w={28} h={28} /><Stack gap={0}><Text fw={700} size="md">Claude Usage</Text><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Abo-Verbrauch</Text></Stack></Group><RefreshButton /></Group>{data.apiError?.state === "1" ? <Alert color="orange">Die Integration meldet einen API-Fehler. Die Werte sind evtl. veraltet.</Alert> : null}{status.session?.loading || status.weekly?.loading ? <Skeleton height={220} radius="md" />: status.session?.error ? <Alert color="red">{status.session?.status === 404 ? "Sensor sensor." + options.prefix + "_session_limit_usage nicht gefunden – Präfix prüfen" : status.session.error}</Alert>: status.weekly?.error ? <Alert color="red">{status.weekly?.status === 404 ? "Sensor sensor." + options.prefix + "_weekly_all_models_limit_usage nicht gefunden – Präfix prüfen" : status.weekly.error}</Alert>: !isFinite(parseFloat(data.session?.state)) ? <Alert color="gray">Die Sensoren sind gerade nicht verfügbar. Integration in Home Assistant prüfen.</Alert>: <Stack gap="xs">{[{ id: "session", label: "Session (5 h)", ok: status.session?.ok === true, pct: parseFloat(data.session?.state), resetsAt: data.session?.attributes?.resets_at, ms: Date.getTime(data.session?.attributes?.resets_at) - Date.now(), elapsed: Math.min(100, Math.max(0, 100 - (Date.getTime(data.session?.attributes?.resets_at) - Date.now()) / 18000000 * 100)) },{ id: "weekly", label: "Woche · alle Modelle", ok: status.weekly?.ok === true, pct: parseFloat(data.weekly?.state), resetsAt: data.weekly?.attributes?.resets_at, ms: Date.getTime(data.weekly?.attributes?.resets_at) - Date.now(), elapsed: Math.min(100, Math.max(0, 100 - (Date.getTime(data.weekly?.attributes?.resets_at) - Date.now()) / 604800000 * 100)) },{ id: "model", label: "Woche · " + (data.model?.attributes?.model ?? options.modelLimit), ok: status.model?.ok === true && (options.modelLimit ?? "") !== "", pct: parseFloat(data.model?.state), resetsAt: data.model?.attributes?.resets_at, ms: Date.getTime(data.model?.attributes?.resets_at) - Date.now(), elapsed: Math.min(100, Math.max(0, 100 - (Date.getTime(data.model?.attributes?.resets_at) - Date.now()) / 604800000 * 100)) }].filter((l) => l.ok && isFinite(l.pct)).map((l) =><Card key={l.id} withBorder radius="md" padding="sm" shadow="sm"><Stack gap={6}><Group justify="space-between" wrap="nowrap"><Text size="sm" fw={600} truncate>{l.label}</Text><Group gap={6} wrap="nowrap">{isFinite(l.elapsed) ? <Badge size="xs" variant="light" tt="none" color={l.pct - l.elapsed >= 1 ? "orange" : l.pct - l.elapsed <= -1 ? "green" : "gray"}>{l.pct - l.elapsed >= 1 ? "+" + Math.round(l.pct - l.elapsed) + " % über Tempo" : l.pct - l.elapsed <= -1 ? Math.round(l.elapsed - l.pct) + " % unter Tempo" : "im Tempo"}</Badge> : null}<Text size="sm" fw={700} c={l.pct >= 90 ? "red" : l.pct >= 75 ? "orange" : "green"}>{Math.round(l.pct) + " %"}</Text></Group></Group><Progress value={Math.min(100, Math.max(0, l.pct))} color={l.pct >= 90 ? "red" : l.pct >= 75 ? "orange" : "green"} size="lg" radius="xl" />{isFinite(l.elapsed) ? <Progress value={l.elapsed} color="gray" size={4} radius="xl" /> : null}<Group justify="space-between" wrap="nowrap"><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">{!isFinite(l.ms) ? "Reset unbekannt" : l.ms <= 0 ? "Reset steht an" : l.ms >= 86400000 ? "Reset in " + Math.floor(l.ms / 86400000) + " T " + Math.floor((l.ms % 86400000) / 3600000) + " h" : "Reset in " + Math.floor(l.ms / 3600000) + " h " + Math.floor((l.ms % 3600000) / 60000) + " min"}</Text><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">{l.resetsAt ? Date.toLocaleString(l.resetsAt, "de-DE", "Europe/Berlin") : ""}</Text></Group></Stack></Card>)}{status.extra?.ok === true && isFinite(parseFloat(data.extra?.state)) ?<Card withBorder radius="md" padding="sm" shadow="sm"><Stack gap={6}><Group justify="space-between" wrap="nowrap"><Text size="sm" fw={600}>Extra Usage</Text><Text size="sm" fw={700}>{Math.round(parseFloat(data.extra.state)) + " %"}</Text></Group><Progress value={Math.min(100, Math.max(0, parseFloat(data.extra.state)))} color="grape" size="lg" radius="xl" /></Stack></Card>: null}</Stack>}</Stack>
